title: Your Unlearning Gives You Away: Identifying Erased Concepts in Diffusion Models

paragraphs.en: Existing attacks on unlearned diffusion models assume that the erased concepts are known in advance and focus on recovering them. In practice, however, model providers may not disclose which concepts have been removed, and even with access to the original base model, an adversary may still lack a clear target to attack. In this paper, we aim to answer the following critical but overlooked questions: which concepts have been erased from the model, and how many have been erased in total? To this end, we present Tracer , a framework that rapidly and accurately identifies erased concepts and estimates their number. Tracer efficiently identifies erased concepts without generating and classifying images. By combining lightweight spectral analysis of weight footprints, it enables efficient search over large candidate vocabularies. To distinguish multiple erased concepts, we introduce a footprint coverage objective that guides sequential discovery. Tracer estimates the number of erased concepts by detecting a sharp decline in candidate confidence as the selected concepts account for the erasure footprint, without requiring labeled examples for calibration. The framework requires only lightweight linear algebra and limited forward probes, with no prior knowledge of the unlearning algorithm. Experiments across text-to-image and text-to-video backbones and diverse unlearning methods demonstrate that Tracer identifies erased concepts and estimates their number in seconds , achieving 𝟏𝟓𝟎 \bm{150} – 137,000 × \bm{137{,}000\times} and 𝟏𝟑𝟑 \bm{133} – 20,000 × \bm{20{,}000\times} speedups over MIA and brute-force search on image and video models, respectively, with substantially higher identification accuracy.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Podell et al., 2023 ; Ding et al., 2022 ) exhibit powerful generative capabilities. Despite these advances, their large-scale deployment has raised concerns about copyright infringement and harmful or biased content generation. Concept unlearning ( Bourtoule et al., 2021 ; Xu et al., 2024 ) aims to suppress designated concepts while preserving other generative capabilities. Most existing methods achieve this by modifying pretrained model weights, demonstrating promising results in unlearning individual concepts or sets of concepts.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型（Rombach 等人，2022；Podell 等人，2023；Ding 等人，2022）展现出强大的生成能力。 尽管取得了这些进展，其大规模部署也引发了对版权侵权以及有害或偏见内容生成的担忧。 概念遗忘（Bourtoule 等人，2021；Xu 等人，2024）旨在抑制指定概念，同时保留其他生成能力。 大多数现有方法通过修改预训练模型的权重来实现这一目标，在遗忘单个概念或一组概念方面展现出良好效果。

paragraphs.en: Existing attacks exploit vulnerabilities in unlearned models to regenerate erased content, but they typically assume prior knowledge of the specific concepts to recover ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Pham et al., 2023 ; Rusanovsky et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024c ; Chin et al., 2023 ; Tsai et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Petsiuk and Saenko, 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ; Horwitz et al., 2024 ) . In practice, model providers may not disclose what they have removed. Even access to the original base model does not directly reveal which of its many concepts the provider chose to erase. For example, a provider may erase a small set of individuals’ identities for privacy reasons. Although the base model may still generate depictions of these individuals, access to this capability alone does not tell an adversary who was selected for protection. Identifying the erased concepts therefore provides information beyond access to the original model: it reveals the provider’s undisclosed targets and allows an adversary to focus subsequent attacks on the content the provider sought to suppress. This raises two critical but overlooked questions: without any prior knowledge of the erasure targets, can an adversary know which concepts have been erased from the model, and how many have been erased in total? To the best of our knowledge, no existing method systematically addresses this identification problem in unlearned diffusion models.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的攻击方法利用未学习模型中的漏洞来重新生成被删除的内容，但这些方法通常假设攻击者事先知道需要恢复的具体概念（Lu et al., 2026；Pham et al., 2023；Rusanovsky et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2024c；Chin et al., 2023；Tsai et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2024；Petsiuk and Saenko, 2024；Liu et al., 2026；Xiang et al., 2026；Horwitz et al., 2024）。 实际上，模型提供商可能不会透露他们删除了哪些内容。 即使能够访问原始基础模型，也无法直接得知提供商选择删除了其众多概念中的哪些。 例如，提供商可能出于隐私原因删除一小部分个体的身份信息。 尽管基础模型可能仍然会生成这些个体的描述，但仅凭对这一能力的访问，无法让攻击者知道究竟是谁被选中进行保护。 因此，识别出被删除的概念所提供的信息超越了单纯访问原始模型：它揭示了提供商未公开的目标，并能让攻击者将后续攻击集中在提供商试图压制的内容上。 这引出了两个关键但被忽视的问题：在没有任何关于删除目标的前提下，攻击者能否知道模型中哪些概念已被删除，以及总共删除了多少个？ 据我们所知，目前没有任何现有方法能够系统性地解决未学习扩散模型中的这一识别问题。

paragraphs.en: Potential approaches include adapting traditional membership inference attacks (MIAs) ( Fu et al., 2023 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Duan et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2022 ; Matsumoto et al., 2023 ) or comparing images generated by the original and unlearned models for each candidate. However, extending these approaches to reliable and efficient identification of unknown erasure targets presents challenges. First , unlearning can affect both target and non-target concepts. Changes in membership scores or generated content therefore cannot reliably distinguish directly targeted concepts from indirectly affected ones. Second , the number of erased concepts is unknown. Identifying the target set requires determining which candidates to select and when to stop, without target labels for calibration. Third , both approaches incur substantial computational costs even with a predefined candidate set. Without a narrowly specified set, the search may span a vocabulary containing tens of thousands of words, making repeated generation or MIA-based probing prohibitively expensive.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce a novel method, Tra cing C oncepts Er ased by Unlearning ( Tracer ), for rapidly and accurately identifying erased concepts and estimates their number without any prior knowledge of the erasure targets. An intuitive but inconclusive approach is to compare the unlearned model weights with its original base model. However, these weight differences span distinct representation spaces, making it difficult to map them directly to erased concepts. To turn these differences into usable evidence , Tracer constructs Gram matrices from weight differences and uses a small set of probe words to identify compatible representation groups, then applies spectral reweighting to balance signals before aggregation, producing an erasure footprint for each group. These footprints provide the basis for identifying candidate concepts whose representations collectively explain the observed changes. To identify multiple erased concepts , we formulate identification as a subspace coverage problem, which measures how much of the erasure footprint a set of candidate concepts can collectively explain. Specifically, starting from an empty set, Tracer iteratively adds the candidate that best explains the remaining footprint energy, reducing redundant selections and directing the search toward other erased concepts. To estimate the number of erased concepts , we track candidate confidence throughout this coverage-based selection process. As the selected concepts account for the dominant footprint energy, a sharp decline in confidence indicates a cutoff in the selected sequence, allowing us to estimate the erased-set size without labeled calibration data. We summarize our contributions as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“通过遗忘追踪被擦除概念”（Tracer）的新方法，能够在没有任何关于擦除目标先验知识的情况下，快速准确地识别出被擦除的概念并估算其数量。 一种直观但无法得出明确结论的方法是，将经过遗忘训练的模型权重与其原始基础模型进行比较。 然而，这些权重差异跨越了不同的表示空间，因此很难将其直接映射到被擦除的概念上。 为了将这些差异转化为可用的证据，Tracer 从权重差异中构建格拉姆矩阵，并利用一组小型探测词来识别兼容的表示组，随后通过谱重加权在聚合前平衡信号，从而为每个组生成一个擦除足迹。 这些足迹为识别候选概念提供了依据，因为这些概念的表示能够共同解释观察到的变化。 为了识别多个被擦除的概念，我们将识别过程表述为一个子空间覆盖问题，用于衡量一组候选概念能够共同解释多少比例的擦除足迹。 具体来说，Tracer 从一个空集开始，迭代地添加最能解释剩余足迹能量的候选概念，从而减少重复选择，并将搜索方向引导至其他被擦除的概念。 为了估算被擦除概念的数量，我们在整个基于覆盖的选择过程中持续跟踪候选概念的置信度。 由于所选概念占据了主要的足迹能量，因此置信度的急剧下降标志着选择序列的截止点，使我们无需带标签的校准数据即可估算出被擦除集合的大小。 我们将我们的贡献总结如下：

sents.zh: 为了识别多个被擦除的概念，我们将识别过程表述为一个子空间覆盖问题，用于衡量一组候选概念能够共同解释多少比例的擦除足迹。

sents.en: Specifically, starting from an empty set, Tracer iteratively adds the candidate that best explains the remaining footprint energy, reducing redundant selections and directing the search toward other erased concepts.
sents.zh: 具体来说，Tracer 从一个空集开始，迭代地添加最能解释剩余足迹能量的候选概念，从而减少重复选择，并将搜索方向引导至其他被擦除的概念。

sents.en: To estimate the number of erased concepts , we track candidate confidence throughout this coverage-based selection process.
sents.zh: 为了估算被擦除概念的数量，我们在整个基于覆盖的选择过程中持续跟踪候选概念的置信度。

sents.en: As the selected concepts account for the dominant footprint energy, a sharp decline in confidence indicates a cutoff in the selected sequence, allowing us to estimate the erased-set size without labeled calibration data.
sents.zh: 由于所选概念占据了主要的足迹能量，因此置信度的急剧下降标志着选择序列的截止点，使我们无需带标签的校准数据即可估算出被擦除集合的大小。

sents.en: We summarize our contributions as follows:
sents.zh: 我们将我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to systematically study erasure-target identification in unlearned diffusion models, exposing an overlooked vulnerability in diffusion unlearning.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，我们是首次系统研究未学习扩散模型中的擦除目标识别问题，揭示了扩散模型遗忘过程中一个被忽视的漏洞。

paragraphs.en: We propose Tracer , an efficient framework that accurately identifies multiple erased concepts from large candidate vocabularies without generating or classifying images, making broad searches for undisclosed erasure targets practical.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Tracer，一个高效的框架，能够在不生成或分类图像的情况下，从大型候选词汇表中准确识别出多个被删除的概念，从而使得对未披露的删除目标进行广泛搜索成为可能。

paragraphs.en: Tracer automatically estimates how many concepts were erased, without labeled calibration examples, knowledge of the unlearning algorithm, or information about which weights were modified.
paragraphs.zh: Tracer 能够自动估算被擦除的概念数量，而无需带标签的校准示例、对遗忘算法的了解，或关于哪些权重被修改的信息。

paragraphs.en: Experiments across text-to-image and text-to-video backbones and diverse unlearning methods show that Tracer accurately identifies erased concepts and estimates their number from large candidate vocabularies in seconds, achieving 𝟏𝟓𝟎 \bm{150} – 137,000 × \bm{137{,}000\times} and 𝟏𝟑𝟑 \bm{133} – 20,000 × \bm{20{,}000\times} speedups over MIA and brute-force search on image and video models, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 在文本到图像和文本到视频基础模型以及多种遗忘方法上进行的实验表明，Tracer 能够准确识别被删除的概念，并在数秒内从大型候选词汇表中估算其数量。与 MIA 和暴力搜索方法相比，它在图像和视频模型上的加速分别达到了 𝟏𝟓𝟎 \bm{150} – 137,000 × \bm{137{,}000\times} 和 𝟏𝟑𝟑 \bm{133} – 20,000 × \bm{20{,}000\times}。

paragraphs.en: Our study aims to identify the concepts targeted for erasure in an unlearned model. Existing attacks (Sec 2.2 ) primarily recover content associated with known erased concepts. Tracer identifies unknown erasure targets and estimates their number without image generation, fine-tuning, or knowledge of the erasure algorithm. This setting shifts the focus from attacking a model to regenerate known erased concepts to identifying which concepts were erased.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究旨在识别未学习模型中被目标清除的概念。 现有的攻击方法（第 2.2 节）主要恢复与已知被清除概念相关的内容。 Tracer 能够识别未知的清除目标，并在无需图像生成、微调或了解清除算法的情况下估算其数量。 这种设定将研究重点从攻击模型以再生已知被清除的概念，转向识别究竟哪些概念被清除。

paragraphs.en: A publisher starts from public base weights W W , applies a published concept-unlearning method (Section 2.1 ) to erase an unknown set S ⋆ S^{\star} of concepts, and releases the resulting edited weights W ′ W^{\prime} . The adversary has access only to W W , W ′ W^{\prime} , and a vocabulary 𝒞 \mathcal{C} of ordinary words assumed to contain S ⋆ S^{\star} . In particular, the adversary knows neither | S ⋆ | |S^{\star}| nor which erasure algorithm was used, has no labelled examples of erased or non-erased models, and therefore cannot construct shadow models for validation. The adversary may evaluate the full computation graph on text inputs and record the inputs to all changed weight matrices, which are identified directly by comparing W W and W ′ W^{\prime} . Text-encoder matrices are probed from the prompt alone, whereas generative-backbone matrices are probed by pairing the prompt with a single fixed latent at several noise levels. Both probes require only the available model weights and architecture. The sampling loop is never executed, no image is decoded, and no model output is observed.
paragraphs.zh: 出版方从公开的基权重 W W 出发，应用一种已公布的遗忘概念方法（第 2.1 节）来消除一组未知的概念 S ⋆ S^{\star}，然后发布经过编辑的权重 W ′ W^{\prime}。 攻击者仅能访问 W W、W ′ W^{\prime} 以及一个包含普通词汇的词表 𝒞 \mathcal{C}，而该词表被认为包含了 S ⋆ S^{\star}。 具体而言，攻击者既不知道 | S ⋆ | |S^{\star}|，也不知道使用了哪种消除算法；他们也没有关于被消除或未消除模型的带标签样本，因此无法构建用于验证的影子模型。 攻击者可以在文本输入上评估完整的计算图，并记录所有被修改的权重矩阵的输入；这些矩阵可通过直接比较 W W 和 W ′ W^{\prime} 来识别。 文本编码器矩阵仅通过提示进行探测，而生成主干矩阵则通过将提示与多个噪声水平下的单个固定潜在变量配对进行探测。 这两种探测方法都只需要可用的模型权重和架构。 采样循环从未执行，没有图像被解码，也没有模型输出被观察到。

paragraphs.en: The goal of the attack is to recover the identities of the erased concepts: a subset S ^ ⊆ 𝒞 \hat{S}\subseteq\mathcal{C} that should coincide with S ⋆ S^{\star} , together with an inferred count n n intended to match | S ⋆ | |S^{\star}| . paragraphs.en: Combining these imprints introduces two challenges. paragraphs.en: We evaluate Tracer on three text-to-image backbones: Stable Diffusion v1.5 ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , Stable Diffusion 3 ( Esser et al., 2024 ) , and FLUX.1 ( Labs, 2024 ) . The text-to-video backbones are CogVideoX-5B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . We use official implementations and released checkpoints without modification. Object identification is evaluated on the ten Imagenette classes ( Howard and others, 2019 ) . Explicit-content evaluation uses I2P prompts ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) . Artistic-style identification covers the artists evaluated by ESD ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ) and UCE ( Gandikota et al., 2024 ) . Generation quality is evaluated on MS COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) . We construct Imagenette-20 by augmenting Imagenette’s ten classes ( Howard and others, 2019 ) with 10 non-overlapping common object categories from ImageNet-1k ( Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) to evaluate identification across varying erased-set sizes. All experiments run on NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs.

paragraphs.en: Reproducing unlearning methods with their official implementations reveals limits on stable erasure capacity. Beyond these limits, models exhibit degraded forgetting or damaged generative capabilities. Shaded cells in Table 1 indicate evaluated settings within these limits; excluded settings are marked “–”. We evaluate varying erased-set sizes, where K K denotes the number of concepts jointly erased from each checkpoint. For each size, we sample concept sets from Imagenette-50, shared across methods and backbones. Each set is jointly erased to produce a checkpoint. We define recovery accuracy as the percentage of checkpoints whose recovered set exactly matches the ground-truth erased set. Correct recovery identifies all erased concepts without extras, jointly testing concept identities and inferred set size. Partial recovery counts as failure. The Avg. column averages recovery accuracy over evaluated set sizes within each method’s stable erasure range, excluding “–”. Higher values indicate better performance ( ↑ \uparrow ). Table 3 extends the same protocol to text-to-video models. Evaluation is restricted to individual concepts and small groups, where the tested methods maintain stable erasure. Tracer achieves perfect recovery for both methods on CogVideoX-5B and for Refusal on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B. For VideoEraser on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, recovery remains perfect for individual concepts, with a modest decline under joint erasure. These results demonstrate that erasure footprints remain informative across video architectures with different temporal modeling, enabling accurate identification of both individual targets and jointly erased concept sets.

paragraphs.en: We compare Tracer with two approaches. Adapted MIA ranks concepts by aggregated changes in sample-level membership scores. Brute-force probing ranks candidates by comparing images generated before and after unlearning. Implementation details are provided in Appendix A.3 . We evaluate ESD, UCE, SPEED, and ScaPre on Stable Diffusion v1.5, with 50 checkpoints per erased-set size K ∈ { 1 , 3 , 5 } K\in\{1,3,5\} . All approaches share checkpoints and 1,000-name vocabulary. To accommodate conventional methods, all receive the true K K ; Tracer uses its iterative selection order without size estimation. Unlike exact-set accuracy, this comparison credits partial recovery. Let T m ( L ) T_{m}^{(L)} contain the first L L candidates for checkpoint m m . We compute Recall ​ @ ​ L = 100 50 ​ ∑ m = 1 50 | T m ( L ) ∩ S m ⋆ | / K \mathrm{Recall@}L=\frac{100}{50}\sum_{m=1}^{50}|T_{m}^{(L)}\cap S_{m}^{\star}|/K , where S m ⋆ S_{m}^{\star} is the erased set. Table 3 reports Recall@ K K for each K K ; recovering three of five targets scores 60%. Recall@10 uses L = 10 L=10 with denominator K K . Its reported value equally averages the three K K settings. Tracer maintains high recall across methods and set sizes, while baseline recall generally declines as K K grows. Allowing ten candidates improves baseline coverage but leaves targets unidentified, supporting the effectiveness of weight footprints beyond behavioral changes alone.

paragraphs.en: We presented Tracer , which accurately identifies erasure targets and their number from publicly released model weights in seconds without image generation. Experiments demonstrate its effectiveness across image and video backbones and diverse unlearning methods. It enables label-free search over large candidate vocabularies, achieving substantial speedups over membership inference attacks and brute-force generation-based probing methods. Our work establishes erasure-target identification as a distinct task and provides a practical and computationally efficient framework for assessing what model weights reveal about erasure targets despite suppressed generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Tracer，它无需生成图像，即可在数秒内从公开发布的模型权重中准确识别擦除目标及其数量。 实验表明，该方法在图像和视频骨干网络以及多种去学习方法中均展现出有效性。 它支持在无标签的情况下从大型候选词汇表中进行搜索，相比成员身份推理攻击和基于暴力生成的探测方法，实现了显著的速度提升。 我们的工作将擦除目标识别确立为一个独立的任务，并提供了一个实用且计算高效的框架，用于评估模型权重在生成被抑制的情况下仍可能揭示哪些擦除目标信息。

paragraphs.en: Table 9 reports the identification accuracy of erased artistic styles across three text-to-image backbones. Tracer achieves perfect identification in nearly all evaluated settings. On Stable Diffusion v1.5, ESD reaches 92 % 92\% when ten styles are erased jointly, yielding an average accuracy of 98.0 % 98.0\% . All other evaluated configurations achieve 100 % 100\% accuracy. UCE, ScaPre, and FIA maintain perfect identification with twenty jointly erased styles. These results demonstrate that weight footprints reveal erasure targets beyond object concepts, extending to artistic styles across different backbones and unlearning methods.

paragraphs.en: We exclude facial-identity unlearning from this evaluation. In our preliminary checks, the tested methods suppress target identities but also degrade the generation of non-target content. These checkpoints therefore provide a limited basis for evaluating target identification under selective unlearning, as their weight changes also reflect broader losses in generative capability.
